subject.title: [Bug]: --to flag ignored when using --agent with custom channel, all sessions map to main

question: Should the per-recipient fix persist raw `--channel`/`--to` identifiers in session keys, or require a bounded/opaque key contract plus upgrade handling before merge?
rationale: The bug is valid and security-sensitive, but automation should not choose the privacy and compatibility contract for persisted recipient-derived session identity.

options.title: Use Bounded Or Opaque Recipient Keys
options.body: Refresh or replace the linked PR with an approved bounded/opaque recipient-key design and tests for explicit `--session-key` and `--session-id` precedence.

options.title: Accept Raw Recipient Keys
options.body: Land raw channel-recipient keys only if maintainers explicitly accept the persisted identifier contract and add upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause The Fix
options.body: Keep the issue open while maintainers choose a different compatibility or privacy design before implementation continues.

recommendation.title: Use Bounded Or Opaque Recipient Keys
recommendation.body: Refresh or replace the linked PR with an approved bounded/opaque recipient-key design and tests for explicit `--session-key` and `--session-id` precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the open linked fix candidate and have recent merged history in the same resolver boundary.
